newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan tenders for 50,000 T sugar.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan tenders for 50,000 T sugar.

text.p: The state-run Trading Corporation of Pakistan (TCP) on Monday invited bids, to be opened on May 24, for 50,000 tonnes of white refined crystal sugar to be delivered in two equal shipments by June 30 and July 15.
The TCP said bids would be opened at 11 a.m. (0600 GMT) on May 24.
The Pakistan Sugar Mills Association says sugar production had reached 2.32 million tonnes by April 15 compared to 2.43 million tonnes at the same time a year ago.
Dealers have bought 1.13 million tonnes, or 49 percent, of the production and the remaining 1.18 million tonnes, is at the mills.
